scope:
Existing pristine WRF PD and RK oracles on actual captured QC operands.

Use the previously registered C05 PD gate: ring>=1 max error bounded by
max(8*WRF FMA/no-FMA spread,1e-5*max|reference|), RMS by
max(8*spread RMS,1e-6*max|reference|). A QC event is source-justified here only
when unchanged WRF also returns negative PD tendency AND negative RK QC at
the same interior source point, and the candidate lies within WRF's own
pointwise FMA/no-FMA interval. This is not a forecast/D6 qualification.

pd_manifest.scope: pristine full advect_scalar_pd; root specified, h5/v3, time_step1, tenddec false; all REAL4
pd_manifest.caller: mut=full current dry mass; mub=base; muold=old perturbation; memories include 4 edge-repeated halo cells; full physical tile
pd_manifest.dimensions: WRF i,k,j; ids/its1,ide nx+1,ite nx; analog y; k1..nz+1, ktf nz

rk_manifest.scope: pristine full rk_update_scalar; specified root, rk_ord 3, tenddec false, all REAL4
rk_manifest.caller: solve_em other_scalar_advance: scalar_1=old, mu_old=mu_1, mu_new=mu_2 (perturbations), mu_base=mub

pd_manifest.scope: pristine full advect_scalar_pd; root specified, h5/v3, time_step1, tenddec false; all REAL4
pd_manifest.caller: mut=full current dry mass; mub=base; muold=old perturbation; memories include 4 edge-repeated halo cells; full physical tile
pd_manifest.dimensions: WRF i,k,j; ids/its1,ide nx+1,ite nx; analog y; k1..nz+1, ktf nz

rk_manifest.scope: pristine full rk_update_scalar; specified root, rk_ord 3, tenddec false, all REAL4
rk_manifest.caller: solve_em other_scalar_advance: scalar_1=old, mu_old=mu_1, mu_new=mu_2 (perturbations), mu_base=mub

deviation: Strict 1x point-compiler interval remains OPEN; 2.20x spread is within the frozen C05 8x envelope. Small absolute FMA-dependent QC deviation disclosed; full-forecast D6 decides, per standing policy. No model clamp added.
